shared_elements: low-relief carved figures on a vertical stone surface
small repeated animal or creature signs within a band
justification: Both surfaces carry relief imagery organised into horizontal registers and both include small profile creature forms repeated within a band, but this is about as generic a correspondence as relief carving allows. A shows a few large, individually posed animals (a canid-like beast, a long-necked bird, a snake-like element, a reclining figure) dominating the field, whereas B is an all-over field of dense, uniform rows of tiny sign-like glyphs with no large figural composition at all.
